model.description: {@link MlModel} that needs to be monitored.

groupByValue.description: The group value that at least the {@link #predictions} are grouped by.

predictions.description:
The predictions from this {@link #model}, and if present, for this
{@link #groupByValue}. If only a single prediction is fetched in {@link MlModel.Monitor.Data#dataGroupsFromSpec},
recommended format is {@link Data}. If multiple predictions (in case of a multi-output model)
are fetched, {@link Map} is used. Suggested key name is one of {@link MlModel#pipeline#outNames}.

labels.description:
The corresponding labels for the predictions from this {@link #model}, and if present, for this
{@link #groupByValue}. If only a single label is fetched in {@link MlModel.Monitor.Data#dataGroupsFromSpec},
recommended format is {@link Data}. If multiple labels (in case of a multi-output model)
are fetched, {@link Map} is used. Suggested key name is one of {@link MlModel#pipeline#outNames}.

contexts.description:
Scoring context to be passed to the {@link MlScoringMetric} that will consume {@link #predictions} and
{@link #labels}.

title: Type for holding individual data group produced by {@link MlModel.Monitor.Data#dataGroupsFromSpec}.
name: MlModel.Monitor.Input
